Foresight is an interactive visualization system that helps users rapidly explore large, high-dimensional datasets using a novel guidepost metaphor that allows users to interactively explore the data through the lens of statistical descriptors.

Foresight, which is a visualization recommender that helps the user explore large datasets through “guidepost” visualizations corresponding to strong instances of statistical descriptors, is effective for interactive exploration of large high-dimensional datasets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a visualization recommender that helps the user quickly find guideposts in large, high-dimensional datasets.
the problem of helping users explore large, complex datasets by providing a rich set of “guideposts” and a flexible interface for navigating among them.

the following questions: What are the most useful statistical descriptors for EDA, and what are the best ways to rank and visualize them? How can we design a system that supports the user in exploring these descriptors in a way that is both fast and effective?

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Foresight is a system that helps users rapidly and efficiently explore large datasets by presenting guideposts that highlight interesting patterns in the data.
Foresight helps users rapidly explore large datasets by focusing on the most prominent features of the underlying data.

Foresight is a system that helps users to explore large-scale data through the lens of data descriptors, and that it does so by presenting a global visualization of the space of descriptors and by allowing users to explore the space of descriptors through a set of guidepost queries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
EDA tools can be made more effective by leveraging the statistical properties of data, and by helping users to rapidly explore the space of guideposts.
EDA can be made more effective and enjoyable by leveraging the power of guideposts.
Foresight can help data scientists quickly find guideposts that can help orient and direct them in their EDA of complex datasets.
